description: This file contains unit tests for the Content class in the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace, focusing on parsing and handling content and front matter in files.

classes.name: ContentTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Content class functionality in the Daux documentation generator project.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Helper method to create a Content object with optional content, used across test cases.

methods.name: providerTestAttributes
methods.description: Data provider supplying various content strings, expected attributes, and final content outputs for parameterized tests.

methods.name: testAttributes
methods.description: Tests that the Content object correctly parses attributes and content from the input string.

methods.name: testAttributeIncorrect
methods.description: Ensures that parsing invalid front matter raises the expected exception.

methods.name: testEmptyContent
methods.description: Checks that empty content triggers an exception.

methods.name: testNoAttributes
methods.description: Verifies behavior when there are no attributes or front matter delimiters.

methods.name: testAttributeOverride
methods.description: Tests that attributes can be overridden programmatically after parsing.

methods.name: testContentPreserved
methods.description: Ensures that content not part of front matter remains unchanged and accessible.
